title: Kodbale
description: Crunchy, ring-shaped spiced snack made with rice flour, chiroti rava, dry coconut, and ajwain, seasoned with red chilli powder and hot ghee.

ingredients.name: Salt to taste & Oil for frying

steps.instruction: In a wide bowl, combine rice flour, chiroti rava, maida, dry coconut, chilli powder, ajwain, chopped curry leaves, hing, and salt.
Heat 2-3 tablespoons of pure ghee until smoking hot and pour directly over the dry flour mixture.
Rub the flour between your palms until the mixture holds its shape when squeezed like breadcrumbs.
Sprinkle water gradually to knead into a smooth, non-sticky dough. Rest covered for 15 minutes.
Pinch small portions, roll into pencil-thick cylinders, and join the ends to form rings (kodbale).
Deep-fry on low-medium flame patiently until deep golden and crunchy throughout.

storyOrOrigin: The quintessential festival and monsoon savory of Karnataka, perfect with a hot tumbler of Mysore filter coffee.
grandmasSecrets: Hot ghee rubbing ('moyan') is what gives the kodbale its lasting flaky crunch.
Fry on low-medium flame; frying on high heat leaves the center chewy instead of crisp.
